name: nso2ida
description: An IDAPython loader for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 NSO, NRO, and KIP executables, with support for compressed segments, symbols, and relocations. Extends ReSwitched's nxo64.py loader.

name: nsnsotool
description: A C command-line utility for compressing and decompressing Nintendo Switch NSO files with LZ4. The 2026 update adds Nintendo Switch 2 support.

name: ouendan_toolkit
description: A Windows C++ toolkit for importing and exporting Nintendo DS Ouendan graphics and working with LZ10/LZSS-compressed data, including tile and palette resources.

name: OEFL_pipeline
description: An analysis workflow for single-cell long-read sequencing of olfactory sensory neurons. Combines Shell and Python preprocessing with R scripts for isoform profiling and figure generation.

name: ATACFragQC
description: A Python quality-control toolkit for bulk and single-cell ATAC-seq fragment data, reporting chromosomal distributions, fragment-length profiles, and transcription start site enrichment.

name: img2gcode
description: A Python command-line utility that converts raster images into G-code for laser-machine workflows.

name: ATAC_QC_Pipline
description: A shell-based ATAC-seq quality-control pipeline integrating read filtering, alignment, duplicate handling, BAM preparation, and fragment-level QC with ATACFragQC.

name: amplicon_handle
description: An R, Python, and Shell workflow for processing amplicon-sequencing reads and identifying mutated codons, from alignment and sequence extraction to filtering and codon-level counting.

name: translate_sse_into_python
description: An experimental Python reference that reimplements selected x86 SSE intrinsics for binary-analysis and reverse-engineering tasks.

name: FLITseq_pipeline
description: An R, Python, and Shell workflow for scWT/FLIT-seq analysis, including preprocessing of bulk and droplet datasets and manuscript figure generation. Updated for Seurat v5.

name: imageConv
description: A C++ library and demonstration tool for processing general, indexed, and tiled image formats, with libimagequant support for palette quantization.

name: mrnaScan
description: A toolkit for analyzing transcript isoforms in full-length mRNA-seq data, including read-level exon combinations and 3'-UTR usage.

name: CellMerge2
description: An image acquisition, stitching, and analysis tool for immunofluorescence analysis, built with C++, Qt, and OpenCV.

name: openmm_class
description: Coursework and examples for OpenMMLab MMClassification and MMDetection, covering ResNet-based flower classification and Mask R-CNN balloon instance segmentation.
